name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
instructions: Select the assistance weight. On this machine the number is how much help you get, not how much you lift — a HIGHER number is EASIER, which is the opposite of every other machine in the gym.
Take the overhead bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders, then kneel or stand on the pad and let it take your weight. This is your starting position, arms straight.
Pull yourself up by driving the elbows down and back until your chin clears the bar. Keep the ribs down rather than swinging.
Lower under control all the way to straight arms.
Reduce the assistance a little as you get stronger. When you can do three sets of eight with the lightest setting, move to an unassisted pull-up.
